about: When two customer messages ask the same question (#243, docs/specs/13-genie.md goal 6: 'the same question repeated three rounds'). Written 2026-10-18 from the shapes customers repeat in: case, punctuation, a dropped article or 'please', a model code typed with spaces instead of hyphens, a shortened restatement. The 'different' pairs keep most words and change what is asked (another model, another document, another value); the pairs marked follow_up are real follow-ups a customer sends after an answer: the same question refined with a feature or a quantity, or asked for a sibling model (review round 1 of #243). #375 round 2 adds the filler pairs (and the pairs that must stay different: a delivery day, noch, German still, a negation dropped either way) so #339 measures the 0-to-0.75 claim on a corpus that contains them. Round 3 adds the language-gate regressions, the inflected date verbs, keiner/keinem/keines, and a grammatical pair for every aktuell ending; currently, derzeit, momentan, zurzeit and yet stay different because they are not fillers. `a` is the earlier message, `b` the later one. contact.SAME is the Jaccard cut these pairs are measured against (tests/test_contact.py, test_339_filler_corpus_holds_for_every_cut_from_0_to_0_75).
